scenario_name: EDGE: vague caller who won't self-serve
watch_for: Did the agent ask clarifying questions, or invent specifics the patient never gave? Did it book something without ever pinning down a day? Did it loop asking the same question?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name to get started.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Oh, um, I think I need to come in, sometime?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: No problem! To help you schedule a visit, would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Looks like there was an issue creating your profile. Let me try that again for you. Your patient profile is set up and your date of birth is July 4th 2000 for demo purposes. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Um, I’ve just been feeling off lately, not great.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Sorry to hear you're not feeling well. Would you like to schedule an appointment to talk with one of our providers about how you're feeling?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, I think an appointment would be good.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Would you say this is more of a general check-in, or do you feel it's something urgent that needs prompt attention? This helps me book the right type of appointment for you.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Um, it's been going on for like two weeks, headaches mostly.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thanks for sharing that. Since your headaches have been going on for a couple of weeks, would you like to book a general office visit to discuss these symptoms?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, that sounds fine, maybe Thursday or Friday?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Oh, afternoon would be better for me.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: There are several openings this Thursday with Dr. Zbigniew Lukasiewicz and Dr. Kelly Noble. Would you prefer morning or afternoon? I can offer you a specific time once you let me know.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: The first available afternoon slot on Thursday is at 2 p.m. with Dr. Zigbee Lukosky. Would you like to book that time?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, let's go ahead and book that 2 p.m. slot.

outcome.summary: Booked a 2 p.m. Thursday appointment with Dr. Zbigniew Lukoski for headaches.
